body.p: The Applicant has carefully considered the Notice To File Corrected Application Papers dated March 9, 2022. By way of this response, please replace FIGs. 1, 2, 4 with the replacement sheets provided with this response. In amending FIGs. 1, 2, 4, no new matter was added. In view of the foregoing, reconsideration and allowance of the subject application are respectfully requested.
For at least the above reasons, the Applicant respectfully submits the items raised in the Notice have been fully addresses. Reconsideration and allowance are courteously solicited.
The Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned at the telephone number listed below to expedite prosecution of this application.
The Commissioner is authorized to charge any necessary fees, or credit any overpayment to the Deposit Account of McAndrews, Held & Malloy, Account No. 13- 0017.
